name: RELIANCE INDS GDR 144A/2
summary: Reliance Industries Limited is an Indian conglomerate company with diverse business interests, including energy, petrochemicals, textiles, retail, and telecommunications. The company is involved in the exploration and production of oil and gas, refining and marketing of petroleum products, and manufacturing of petrochemicals and textiles. Reliance Industries aims to be a global leader in its various business sectors.
